tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: The mark's loop, arrowhead and the wordmark hyphen. Fills and large shapes only: 2.8:1 on white, so never small text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark letters and the dot on light grounds; the background of icon.svg, favicon.svg and the social preview.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: The wordmark letters and the dot on brand-ink grounds (wordmark-white.svg, mark-white.svg).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is brand-white; dark is brand-ink, matching the icon and social preview.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table headers, cards sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A deliberately contrasting slab (hero band, callout). Pair with text-inverse.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on surface and surface-raised (17.8:1 light, 16.3:1+ dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, table metadata on surface and surface-raised (5.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary fills: buttons, badges, the active tab underline, highlights in diagrams. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (6.35:1). Never white: white on orange is 2.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and orange inline text on surface (5.6:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet orange wash behind callouts and selected rows; text on it stays text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; not for control outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines (3:1+ on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px. 5.6:1 on white, 6.35:1 on brand-ink.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines and the name set in type. Echoes the monospaced wordmark.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: As in Kotlin, a zero or negative count does nothing.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: This API will ship in the next release (1.0.0).
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, table cells; usually in text-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code, on surface-raised.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, compact padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and code-block padding; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a card; clear space around the mark at 100px.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters and hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App-icon tiles and large panels; the favicon's corner (20 on a 100 grid).
